To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fracture strength of implant abutments is affected by the design of the abutment connection.

the implant abutments of the Branemark, Compress, Frialit 2000, and Screw Vent systems were more susceptible to fatigue and fracture failure than the abutments of Replace Select and Camlog systems, which were the strongest.
implant abutment systems with long internal connections and cam slot design showed the best performance in terms of fatigue resistance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and testing of a new implant abutment interface.
the influence of long-term dynamic loading on the fatigue strength of different implant-abutment connections.
the biomechanical aspects of the implant-abutment connection and its influence on the fracture strength.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
implant systems with long internal connections have the highest fracture strength, followed by implant systems with external connections.
internal connection types are superior to external connection types.
the implant abutments with the highest strength were the ones with internal connections.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the design of the implant abotment connection is a critical factor for the long term stability and survival of implant systems and that the implant abotument connection should be designed to minimize the risk of fracture.
the internal connection designs of the tested systems are superior to the external connection designs with respect to the longevity of the implant-abutment connection.
the implant abutments should have a long internal tube in the tube connection and the implant should have a cam slot.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of the abutment interface plays an important role for the fracture strength of implant abutments.
there are significant differences in the fracture strength of implants with different abutment connection designs.
the implant abutments are not as durable and strong as the implant itself, and that the implant abbutment connection is a weak point in implant dentistry.
